Give your guests a merry welcome with this set of 4 Christmas tree path finders. LED LIGHTS: The Christmas pathfinder trees feature bright LED lights throughout the 4 trees, equating to 1 per tree. Battery powered with a 50 metre power cable with 6 hours timer function.
INDOOR AND OUTDOOR USE: Whilst suitable for lighting up the pathway to your home outside, the trees would also make great use illuminating your hallway or along a wall in your living room. Wherever you use the trees they are sure to bring the festive spirit to your house.

5056141067278.variantName: 20cm Reindeer Shape Birch Bark Wooden Christmas Table Top Decoration
5056141067278.sourceDescription:
Bring a natural festive touch to your seasonal display with this reindeer-shaped birch bark wooden decoration. Designed for Christmas styling, it offers a charming woodland look that suits tabletops, shelves and mantels, helping you create a warm and welcoming home atmosphere through the season. The freestanding design makes it easy to place wherever you want a decorative focal point, while the lightweight construction keeps it simple to move and reposition as needed. Finished with detailed pine needles, cones, berries and hanging bells, this piece adds texture and character to your holiday decor without overpowering your existing arrangement. Made from genuine birch bark, it combines a rustic feel with a thoughtful eco-conscious approach, making it a lovely choice for homes that favour natural seasonal styling. Its deer-inspired silhouette and intricate detailing give it an appealing handcrafted look, ideal for adding interest to Christmas centrepieces, side tables or mantel displays. This decoration also makes a meaningful seasonal gift for family and friends, offering a heartfelt way to share the joy of Christmas. Whether used on its own or as part of a wider festive setting, it brings a classic winter feel with a nature-inspired finish that complements traditional and contemporary decor alike. Practical, decorative and easy to place, it is a simple way to enhance your home for the holidays with a warm woodland theme.
Freestanding reindeer-shaped decoration for easy styling on tabletops, shelves and mantels throughout the festive season.
Made from genuine birch bark for a natural woodland look that suits traditional and contemporary Christmas decor.
Detailed with pine needles, cones, berries and hanging bells to add texture, charm and seasonal character.
Lightweight yet sturdy design makes it easy to move, position and refresh your holiday display with minimal effort.
A thoughtful Christmas gift idea for family and friends, bringing a warm and meaningful festive touch to the home.
Indoor Use
Not resistant to shattering

5052532180878.sourceDescription:
Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Washable Design
The washable design supports regular care after everyday use. Follow the product care directions for the appropriate washing method and allow the item to dry before storing it.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Polyester. Product measurements: length 14 cm, width 10 cm. Product weight: 0.02 kg. Quantity: 1 piece.
Washable and reusable design for lasting festive enjoyment.
Compact mini figure size perfect for detailed displays.
Durable polyester material ensures long-lasting quality.
Versatile Christmas ornament to enhance any home decor.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Included: 1 piece

5056903233378.sourceDescription:
Bring rose gold foliage into your seasonal decorating with this pack of 4 artificial ficus garlands, each measuring 1.8m. Pointed leaf shapes branch along the garland, bringing an open leafy outline and a glittered surface to festive arrangements. The glitter finish adds a decorative accent to Christmas displays, while the rose gold colour helps coordinate the arrangement with your chosen ribbons and ornaments. Lay a length along a mantel, arrange it around a banister or incorporate it into a festive window display. The artificial leaves can also form part of Christmas table centrepieces, wreath-making projects and indoor wedding decorations, allowing the same foliage style to appear in different areas. Plan each length around the space available and position your own accessories alongside it to complete the look. This option contains 4 separate garlands, allowing you to repeat the design across several locations or arrange individual lengths alongside one another. Combine the glittered foliage with plain decorations for contrasting texture, or use it within a wider festive colour theme for your home or party setting.
Glitter Ficus Garland: Includes 4 matching rose gold artificial ficus leaf garlands, each measuring 1.8m. The glitter finish adds colour and texture to Christmas tree decorations, mantel arrangements and festive table displays, with decorative foliage spaced along the length for a leafy seasonal accent.
Decorative Leaf Design: Pointed leaf shapes branch along the garland, bringing an open leafy outline and a glittered surface to festive arrangements. The rose gold colour can be used as the main accent or combined with other seasonal decorations, adding a leafy detail to indoor Christmas and party displays.
Mantel And Stair Decor: Arrange the 1.8m foliage length along a mantel, position it around a banister or use it within a Christmas window display. Plan the layout to suit your space, then add your own ribbons and ornaments to coordinate the garland with nearby festive decorations.
Table And Wreath Arrangements: Incorporate the rose gold ficus foliage into Christmas table centrepieces, decorative wreath projects or indoor wedding displays. The glittered leaves provide a repeated accent that can link place settings, mantel greenery and other seasonal arrangements.
Pack Size And Coverage: Contains 4 separate garlands, each with a 1.8m decorative length. Arrange the individual lengths across separate areas or alongside one another. Coordinate with your own ribbons and ornaments to carry the foliage theme through your indoor seasonal arrangement.

Gold cord comes pre-tied, so nothing needs doing before it goes up. Being acrylic rather than glass it's entirely safe anywhere, including low down on branches where small hands will pull at it, and flat enough to store without padding come January.

Add a touch of wintry magic anywhere with this battery operated acrylic reindeer from MySmartBuy. 24 bright white lights make the clear acrylic glow with a crisp, frosty sparkle. With no need for mains power, it can go on porches, pathways, windowsills, shelves and tables, indoors or out. It runs on batteries, so there are no cables to trail and no need for a nearby socket, and the built-in timer lights it for 6 hours and then switches it off for 18 hours, so it comes on at the same time every evening without you needing to remember. Light up figures are one of the easiest ways to make your home stand out at Christmas. Group several together to tell a festive story on the lawn, use them to frame the front door or path, or place one where it can be seen from the window so the whole family can enjoy it from inside too. Pair it with other MySmartBuy light up figures, trees and wreaths to build a full festive display that neighbours, visitors and passers-by will love. At a glance: acrylic reindeer | 24 bright white lights | battery operated | transparent cable | 6 hours on / 18 hours off timer | indoor and outdoor use.

NO MAINS NEEDED : Place it wherever it looks best.
TRANSPARENT CABLE : For neat, discreet placement.

Suitable for reuse between celebrations, this Christmas tree skirt set offers a balance of style and convenience. It is a versatile decorative accessory for anyone looking to add a seasonal accent to their holiday setup, with a design that supports easy storage and repeat use. 5052532164878.sourceDescription:
Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red and green finish and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Red Berry Accents
Red berry accents introduce small points of colour among the surrounding foliage. They add contrast to the festive arrangement and make it straightforward to repeat a red colour theme across neighbouring Christmas accessories.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Red and Green. Stated size: 26 cm. Quantity: 2 pack.
Includes two festive wreaths for coordinated home decoration.
Features realistic red berry accents to enhance the seasonal display.
Durable plastic construction ensures long-lasting use year after year.
Compact 26 cm size fits perfectly on doors, walls or mantelpieces.
Comes with 2 x Christmas Wreaths

5096042276478.variantName: Christmas wreath - Christmas door wreath - Velvet bow, bell and reindeer for hanging on a door or wall - Green and red, 30 cm
5096042276478.sourceDescription:
A velvet bow, bell and reindeer draw the eye to the centre of this 30 cm arrangement. Pine-style greenery and red berries frame the Christmas greeting, giving a compact decoration quite a few details to discover.

A wreath puts the decoration on the door or wall itself, leaving the console or mantelpiece below free for cards and winter flowers. Its outline is complete in one piece, which is handy in an entrance where there is little space for a tree. Velvet catches light differently as the direction of the pile changes. A spot where daylight falls from one side gives the fabric a deeper colour in the folds and a softer highlight along its edges.

For a simpler finish, keep additional decorations to one part of the ring and let the natural shape of the foliage show elsewhere. A ribbon tied off-centre can pick up a colour from the tree without covering the sprigs. Small red berries show especially clearly against a simple backdrop. If you want to tie the wreath into a larger Christmas scheme, repeat their red in a nearby ornament and let the foliage provide the quieter colour.

Fine pine-style sprigs lend themselves to a simple woodland scheme. A plain background keeps the outline of the needles visible, especially where the foliage spreads towards the edge of the decoration.

On a mantel wall, the wreath can sit above the display while the shelf below stays clear for cards and small ornaments. Leave a little space between the top of the cards and the bottom of the wreath so their outlines remain distinct. If you already have a busy Christmas tree, give the wreath a space of its own. A quiet patch of wall brings the outline into focus and gives visitors a chance to see the individual details as they pass.

After the festive season, lay the decoration in a box with space around its edges.
Compact 30 cm design ideal for small entrances or walls where space is limited.
Features a plush velvet bow, decorative bell and reindeer for festive charm.
Artificial pine foliage and red berries create a realistic woodland Christmas look.
Ready to hang decoration that keeps console tables clear for cards and ornaments.

5096042277178.sourceDescription:
Dried coconut pieces overlap like flower petals on this handmade dusty pink wreath. A sisal back and metal hanging ring help it sit neatly against a wall. At 9 cm deep it shows the layered texture in profile. Choose a dry indoor spot. Choose an indoor position where the details can stay on show throughout the festive season. At 40 cm across, it is easy to measure out the space it will occupy before choosing a position.

A wreath puts the decoration on the door or wall itself, leaving the console or mantelpiece below free for cards and winter flowers. Its outline is complete in one piece, which is handy in an entrance where there is little space for a tree.

If you plan to use the wreath in a group, set it out with your other decorations before you hang them. A little breathing room around its edge usually shows the shapes more clearly than placing several pieces edge to edge. To carry the colours into the rest of the room, pick out one detail from the wreath and repeat it in wrapping ribbon, a table runner or decorations on the tree. Even a single matching accent can bring two separate displays together.

On a mantel wall, the wreath can sit above the display while the shelf below stays clear for cards and small ornaments. Leave a little space between the top of the cards and the bottom of the wreath so their outlines remain distinct. A narrow ribbon in a colour taken from the design makes a discreet finishing touch if you use your own hanger. Varying the length of the ribbon lets you line up the centre of the wreath with a panel or a nearby mirror.

A simple way to plan the setting is to mark the centre of the intended space with a small piece of paper. Hold the decoration over it, then step back to see how it sits alongside the door surround or other wall decorations.
Handmade from dried coconut pieces and sisal with a dusty pink finish.
Includes a metal hanging ring for easy display on doors or walls.
Compact 40 cm diameter design ideal for festive indoor decoration.
Features layered texture and 9 cm depth for visual interest.
Hanging rope included

5058194841478.sourceDescription:
Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red finish and fabric construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Product details
Material: Fabric. Colour: Red. Quantity: 1 set.
Festive red fabric wreath designed to add a defined decorative detail to your Christmas display.
Versatile decoration suitable for creating a focal point on doors, walls or mantelpieces.
Single set quantity allows for easy coordination with other seasonal accessories and accents.
Compact design ensures it fits well in various spaces without overwhelming the surrounding decor.
Comes with 1x Christmas Wreath

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show

Plan the display

Care and presentation
